assets.name: Energy Pickup V2

prompt_notes: Use a compact vertical diamond silhouette that reads immediately as a collectible pickup
No long horizontal extensions, barrel, grip, trigger, handle, launcher shape, magnifying-glass shape, floating particles, aura, letters, numbers, or extra objects

assets.name: Plasma Proximity Mine V2
assets.description: a low-profile deployable proximity mine with a broad stable gunmetal base, four short armored sensor fins, central cyan detection core, and one small violet arming indicator
prompt_notes: Show the complete mine from a slightly elevated side view so its footprint reads clearly
The object silhouette must end cleanly at its base with empty background immediately below it
No floor, cast shadow, puddle, smear, glow beneath the device, warning text, skull symbol, or extra device; violet is limited to the small indicator and integrated casing accents

notes: Immutable targeted revisions of the two V1 quality holds. No generated item joins the public product until human review and a versioned package-extension gate.
